message.content:
**MSFT** is the ticker symbol used on Yahoo Finance (and most other financial platforms) to represent **Microsoft Corporation**.  
- **Exchange:** NASDAQ  
- **Industry:** Technology / Software & Services  
- **Full company name:** Microsoft Corporation  
- **Yahoo Finance URL:** https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT

So when you see “MSFT” on Yahoo Finance, it’s referring to Microsoft’s publicly traded shares.
